releases.title: Live Update & What’s New System
releases.summary: The platform can now detect newer GitHub releases, notify learners safely, and explain what changed.
highlights: Automatic update check every 5 minutes with no-cache version lookup.
Safe Update Now flow that preserves local Study progress and saved results.
Updates are deferred while an exam is active — never forced mid-attempt.
What’s New appears once per installed version and remains available from Profile and Footer.
Recent update history is available inside the platform.

releases.title: Technical Feedback CSS Hotfix
releases.summary: Fixed SQL and other technical answers breaking into one token per line inside feedback cards.
highlights: SQL feedback code blocks render at normal height again.
Syntax-highlight tokens stay inline in feedback, review and Official QBank surfaces.
Exact four-line SQL regression added to Pre-Deploy QA.

releases.title: SQL Study V2
releases.summary: SQL Study became a full teaching experience and internal syllabus diagnostics moved out of the learner path.
highlights: 34 SQL Study sections with visual teaching models.
Syllabus Coverage retained inside collapsed Platform Diagnostics.

releases.title: Code Parser Hardening
releases.summary: Improved Python code-block parsing for loops, list literals, lambda and Pandas answer choices.
highlights: 755 Python questions audited with zero fragmented code programs.
Improved code-only answer detection and task labels.
Display-only Bidi cleanup without changing official source text.

releases.title: Universal Code Readability
releases.summary: Unified code rendering across Python, SQL, DAX, Excel formulas and Power Query M.
highlights: Language badges, syntax highlighting and line numbers.
Code-aware question options, feedback and review.
Responsive LTR code blocks across the platform.
